data.name: Agnivesh
data.gender_notes: Agnivesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Agnivesh means 'Fire God'. Agni is the god of fire, and the suffix 'vesh' indicates that the god is the possessor of that quality. In Hinduism, Agni is considered as the god of the hearth, and he is also the god of the sacrificial fire. The name Agnivesh carries the meaning “Fire God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Agnivesh usually hope their child will grow to embody fire god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Agnivesh is a spiritual name that represents the inner fire of the soul. It is believed that the name bestows the qualities of courage, strength, and determination upon the bearer. Agnivesh is also believed to be a healer, and the name is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be healers or spiritual leaders.
data.etymology: Agnivesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fire God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Agnivesh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

Fire is associated with purification, transformation, and the continuity of life. The rituals and ceremonies in Hinduism involve the use of fire as a representation of the god and as an offering to the gods.
